idea.name: Long Yards storage yard rentals

acquisition_channels.details: Chris describes approaching potential customers at red lights and Home Depot, leaving flyers on vehicles, and meeting prospective tenants at the site.
He calls the early outreach cold-calling and says he approached contractors and tow-truck drivers.
He says people searching need to be able to find the business; whether this means organic search or paid search is unclear.
He names Google and Facebook and reports marketing spend, but does not clearly separate ad spend from other marketing.
He names MLS platforms and says he posted on a marketplace; the marketplace listings may refer to a staff recruitment post.

ideas.delivery: The company leases or partners for land, builds fenced yards with gates, and rents spaces month to month. Tenants visit to view the site; staff handle calls, sales, customer service, site checks, security and cleanup. Long boxes and offices are additional space products.
ideas.other_uk_rules: For UK cold marketing calls, screen numbers against TPS and CTPS as applicable. Check planning permission, land-use and environmental constraints before operating a storage yard; UK GDPR applies to CCTV and tenant data.
